reviews.author: Another Planet’s Hell
reviews.text: I'm baffled by the low ratings. This is the only alternative to the previous Allow Right-Click extension I was using (which Google depreciated due to Manifest 3) that works AND does so globally (on all website). Thank you immensely for this.

reviews.text:
This extensions is great and very useful even on very protected russian websites. 
Only problem is that it's been causing CloudFlare human verification endless loops for years now. An update would be welcomed. As it is one has to deactivate this extension every time one needs to validate a CloudFlare test.
